As the red one touches the blue one when the player turns around, they merge into one zone that covers more of the screen. After combining, every 10 kills translates to 1 order of magnitude more score for each zone (e.g. 180 kills turns into e18). It has a longer
and Duration, and the Area decreased.

Note that the value of x is dependent on if the counters have been combined, defaulting to 0.05 if they have not been, but 0.125 if they have. This means the base damage will scale 2.5 times faster when the counters are combined.

NaneInferno has a 1.5 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 1.5 seconds by the same damage zone. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.

Upon evolving Infernolatro into NaneInferno, Outer Saboteur is removed from the passive slot and turns into Inner Saboteur, placed over the character's face and can still evolve other Ante Chamber DLC weapons. Obtaining NaneInferno from a
will give the player the option of obtaining Outer Saboteur via a Level Up.

With Limit Break, NaneInferno can be further leveled up.

NaneInferno does not have to get kills to benefit from them. The player can take other weapons for safety.
The player should consistently move in the same direction, either clockwise or counter-clockwise, if they wish to combine the damage zones of this weapon.
Zones move faster as more enemies are killed, making the blue one harder to catch up, and excess lag can prevent the damage zones from combining.
This weapon is a reference to the "
, which is essentially the maximum possible score that can be obtained in the game. The name of this weapon, NaneInferno, contains the notation "naneinf", which is derived from that notation.

1.8e308 is the largest number that can be depicted in double-precision floating-point format, the point at which a "naneinf" is obtained in Balatro (reaching it will lead to game crushing, ironically). Thus, reaching it triggers the special effects of NaneInferno.
The blue part of the weapon icon refers to
and the red part refers to

. Their value gets multiplied to get an initial score before other multipliers kick in, which is referenced by how the zones of flame of the weapon work. The infinite symbol again references the Naneinf score.
